query: CoreWeave stock price since IPO and lockup expiration
normalized: coreweave expiration ipo lockup price since stock

output.content:
**CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) stock performance:** the March 2025 IPO was priced at **$40.00 per Class A share**, and trading began on **March 28, 2025**. [[1]]

| Milestone | Close / IPO price | Change vs. $40 IPO |
|---|---:|---:|
| IPO price / first trading day — Mar. 28, 2025 | **$40.00** | — [[2, 3]]|
| Record closing high — Jun. 20, 2025 | **$183.58** | **+359.0%** [[4]]|
| Day before Q2 earnings — Aug. 12, 2025 | **$148.75** | **+271.9%** [[5]]|
| Q2-results selloff — Aug. 13, 2025 | **$117.76** | **+194.4%** [[5]]|
| Accelerated lock-up expiration date — Aug. 14, 2025 | **$99.51** | **+148.8%** [[5]]|
| Next trading day — Aug. 15, 2025 | **$99.97** | **+149.9%** [[5]]|
| Latest available close — Oct. 16, 2026 | **$61.39** | **+53.5%** [[6]]|

**Lock-up interpretation:** the IPO prospectus contained a standard **180-day** lock-up provision, which created some references to a late-September 2025 expiry. [[2]] 

However, the economically important event was the **accelerated release for roughly 84% of shares**: it expired at the **close of trading on the second trading day after CoreWeave announced Q2 earnings**, which was **August 14, 2025**. [[7]] 

CRWV fell from **$148.75 on August 12** to **$99.51 on August 14**, a **33.1% decline** spanning the earnings announcement and anticipated lock-up release; it then closed essentially flat at **$99.97 on August 15**, the first session after those shares became sale-eligible. [[5]] 

At the latest available **$61.39** close, CRWV remained **53.5% above its $40 IPO price**, but was **38.3% below** its August 14, 2025 lock-up-expiration close. [[6]]
